title: Add benchmark-lab mixed-workload profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v49
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds v49 mixed-workload profiling baselines and a reporting pipeline; improves representative runner stability and adds nightly aggregation jobs.
description: Context: the benchmark-lab mixed workload suite has grown with several ad-hoc runners and inconsistent baseline collection. This PR consolidates the mixed-workload profiling baselines, introduces deterministic dataset seeding, stabilizes representative workload runners for latency/cold-start profiling, and wires a reporting pipeline that aggregates nightly runs into the perf warehouse. Changes include data schema migration for baseline artifacts, new CI jobs for stability gating, and dashboards updating. Motivation: improve comparability across runs, reduce noise in baseline regressions, and enable automated alerts on regressions detected by the reporting pipeline. Scope: baseline generation logic in benchmark-lab, representative runners stabilization, reporting pipeline (Airflow + reporting worker), migration scripts, and docs. Testing: unit tests for runner seeding and baseline exporter, end-to-end nightly job in staging, manual verification of aggregated metrics and dashboards. Checklist: [x] baseline generation and seeding implemented, [x] representative runner fixes and retry/backoff, [x] reporting DAG and job config, [x] migration script and rollback plan, [x] CI tests added, [x] dashboards updated. Rollout plan: deploy to staging nightly for 3 days, validate stability, then promote to production during maintenance window with monitoring and quick rollback if regression rate > 2%.
